task: Repair one-argument Map.get write-through across the checker, Fast Debug, and native lowering.
observation: The interpreter and native emitter disagreed because Map.get was represented as an owned/cloned value in consumers and the checker storage-place analysis recognized indexed projections but not Map.get projections. Extending the checker's existing bounded local ownership analysis gave the emitter a READ/WRITE fact; the native emitter now uses get_mut only for a checked WRITE. ORACLE-57 produces 9\n9 in all three engines, while the read-only Map.get fixture remains valid.
impact: The structured oracle isolated the consumer mismatch, while a source inspection showed the required checked alias fact was absent. Extending the established fact path repaired behavior without making the consumer infer mutability.

resolution.summary: Checker-issued projection ownership facts now authorize native mutable Map.get lowering; Fast Debug resolves the same projection under that checked fact. The 3-engine parity and missing-expression-tree corruption tests pass.
